name: IMPRESS
aliases: Investigation for Maximal Peyronie's Reduction Efficacy and Safety Studies
registry: NCT01221597 (AUX-CC-803, IMPRESS I) and NCT01221623 (AUX-CC-804, IMPRESS II)
question: Does intralesional collagenase clostridium histolyticum with plaque modeling reduce penile curvature and bother more than placebo with modeling in men with stable Peyronie's disease?

arms.label: Intralesional collagenase clostridium histolyticum (0.58 mg per injection) with plaque modeling

design.population: 832 men aged 18 or older with stable Peyronie's disease of at least 12 months and dorsal or lateral curvature of 30° to 90°.
design.description: Two identical double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized phase 3 trials
design.locator: abstract; FDA label §14.2 and Table 9; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01221597 and NCT01221623

verdictNote: Both co-primary endpoints were met in each trial; the pooled net curvature difference was 7.7°.
takeaway: In two placebo-controlled trials of stable Peyronie's disease with 30° to 90° curvature, intralesional collagenase clostridium histolyticum with plaque modeling reduced curvature and bother more than placebo with modeling at 52 weeks (pooled curvature 34% versus 18.2%); three corporal ruptures needed surgical repair.

reports.label: Two phase 3 trials, 52 weeks
reports.citation: Gelbard M, Goldstein I, Hellstrom WJ, et al. Clinical efficacy, safety and tolerability of collagenase clostridium histolyticum for the treatment of Peyronie disease in 2 large double-blind, randomized, placebo controlled phase 3 studies. *J Urol.* 2013;190(1):199-207. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2013.01.087
reports.followUp: 52 weeks: up to 4 treatment cycles at weeks 0, 6, 12 and 18, then non-treatment follow-up to week 52

results.measure: Mean percent change in curvature from baseline to week 52 (adjusted, last observation carried forward, mITT 199 versus 104); percentage-point difference (CCH minus placebo)
results.locator: FDA label §14.2, Table 10 (Study 1, adjusted mITT values); Gelbard 2013 Table 2 (IMPRESS I, unadjusted −37.6% versus −21.3%, P = 0.0005)

results.measure: Mean percent change in curvature from baseline to week 52 (adjusted, last observation carried forward, mITT 202 versus 107); percentage-point difference (CCH minus placebo)
results.locator: FDA label §14.2, Table 10 (Study 2 is IMPRESS II); the publication's Table 2 gives unadjusted means of −30.5% versus −15.2% (P = 0.0059)

results.measure: Mean change in Peyronie's Disease Questionnaire bother domain score (0 to 16, higher is worse) from baseline to week 52 (mITT 199 versus 104); difference (CCH minus placebo)
results.note: Lower confidence limit is close to zero.
results.locator: FDA label §14.2, Table 11 (Study 1); the publication's Table 2 gives −3.3 versus −2.0 (P = 0.0451)

results.measure: Mean change in Peyronie's Disease Questionnaire bother domain score (0 to 16, higher is worse) from baseline to week 52 (mITT 202 versus 107); difference (CCH minus placebo)
results.note: Lower confidence limit is close to zero.
results.locator: FDA label §14.2, Table 11 (Study 2); the publication's Table 2 gives −2.4 versus −1.6 (P = 0.0496)

results.measure: Post hoc pooled mean percent improvement in curvature at week 52
results.note: Post hoc meta-analysis of IMPRESS I and II.

results.measure: Post hoc pooled mean change in curvature at week 52, degrees (mean ± SD); difference (CCH minus placebo)
results.note: The 7.7° difference is stated in the AUA 2015 guideline discussion; the abstract gives the two means.

results.measure: Post hoc pooled mean change in PDQ symptom bother score at week 52 (mean ± SD); difference (CCH minus placebo)
results.note: The difference is the subtraction of the two reported means.

results.measure: Mean IIEF overall satisfaction score, baseline to week 52, combined analysis of both trials
results.note: The between-arm difference was statistically significant in the combined analysis (P = 0.0189) and not significant in IMPRESS I (P = 0.0800) or IMPRESS II (P = 0.1168) analyzed separately.

harms.label: Penile hematoma
harms.note: Pooled placebo-controlled trials through day 365, CCH n=551, placebo n=281; includes injection site hematoma.

harms.label: Penile swelling
harms.note: Includes penile edema, scrotal swelling and injection site swelling.

harms.label: Penile pain
harms.note: Includes injection site pain and discomfort.

harms.label: Penile ecchymosis
harms.note: Label grouping: contusion, ecchymoses, penile hemorrhage and injection site hemorrhage; the publication's Table 3 uses a broader penile ecchymosis term that also includes hematoma (80.0% versus 26.0%).

harms.label: Erectile dysfunction reported as an adverse reaction
Severe penile or injection site hematoma
Penile popping sound or sensation
harms.note: Sometimes accompanied by detumescence, hematoma or pain; the label prints 0.3% for the placebo case.

harms.label: Corporal rupture requiring surgical repair
harms.note: All three were surgically repaired. The report's appendix records that all three occurred during intercourse, one of them during the required 14-day period without intercourse after treatment.

harms.label: Serious adverse events (corporal rupture or penile hematoma)
harms.note: Corporal rupture in 3 and penile hematoma in 3; of the 3 hematomas, 1 healed spontaneously, 1 was aspirated and 1 was surgically addressed.

harms.label: Corporal rupture in all Peyronie's disease studies
harms.note: Controlled and uncontrolled trials, 1,044 CCH-treated men and 7,466 injections. In another 9/1044 (0.9%) ecchymosis or hematoma, sudden detumescence or a popping sound occurred and rupture could not be excluded; severe penile hematoma occurred in 39/1044 (3.7%).

harms.label: Penile shortening
harms.note: CCH was not associated with shortening of penile length.

delivery.label: Treatment regimen
delivery.value: Up to 4 cycles 6 weeks apart; each cycle two injections of 0.58 mg collagenase clostridium histolyticum or placebo 24 to 72 hours apart, then clinician plaque modeling 24 to 72 hours after the second injection (maximum 8 injections and 4 modeling procedures)

delivery.label: Home modeling
delivery.value: Patients were instructed to model the penis at home for 6 weeks after each cycle

delivery.label: Allocation
delivery.value: 2:1 to CCH or placebo, stratified by baseline curvature (30° to 60° versus 61° to 90°)

delivery.label: Randomized and dosed
delivery.note: IMPRESS I 277 versus 140 and IMPRESS II 274 versus 141.

delivery.label: Efficacy population (mITT)
delivery.note: Required baseline and at least one later curvature and PDQ assessment and vaginal intercourse within 3 months before each PDQ assessment: 401 CCH and 211 placebo.

delivery.label: Completed the study
delivery.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov participant flow, NCT01221597 and NCT01221623
delivery.note: Sum of the two registry records: 241 and 236 CCH, 124 and 127 placebo.

reports.label: Pooled subgroup analysis
reports.citation: Lipshultz LI, Goldstein I, Seftel AD, et al. Clinical efficacy of collagenase Clostridium histolyticum in the treatment of Peyronie's disease by subgroup: results from two large, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, phase III studies. *BJU Int.* 2015;116(4):650-656. doi:10.1111/bju.13096

results.measure: CCH versus placebo, baseline to week 52, by baseline curvature, disease duration, calcification and erectile function
results.note: Reductions occurred in every subgroup. Curvature reductions were significantly greater with CCH for baseline curvature 30° to 60° (n=492) and 61° to 90° (n=120), disease duration over 2 to 4 years (n=212) and over 4 years (n=199), no calcification (n=447) and IIEF 17 or higher (n=480); not significant for duration 1 to 2 years (n=201), non-contiguous stippling (n=103), contiguous calcification not interfering with injection (n=62), IIEF 1 to 5 (n=22) and IIEF 6 to 16 (n=106).

results.measure: CCH versus placebo, baseline to week 52, by subgroup
results.note: Bother reductions were significantly greater with CCH for curvature 30° to 60°, disease duration over 4 years, no calcification, and IIEF 1 to 5 and 17 or higher.

reports.label: Safety by curvature at injection
reports.citation: Hellstrom WJG, Tan RBW, Liu G. Safety profile of collagenase clostridium histolyticum stratified by degree of penile curvature in patients with Peyronie disease. *Urology.* 2017;106:237.e9-237.e14. doi:10.1016/j.urology.2017.05.004

harms.label: Treatment-related adverse events by curvature at injection
harms.note: Men who received at least 2 cycles: 1,204 cycles at 30° or more and 289 cycles under 30°. Penile swelling 21.1% (curvature under 30°) versus 14.5% (30° or more), P=0.007; penile hemorrhage 12.8% versus 8.9%, P=0.046; skin hyperpigmentation 1.0% versus 0.1%, P=0.025. Most other treatment-related events, and serious ones, were similar between groups.

reports.label: Phase 4 follow-up to 5 years
reports.citation: Goldstein I, Lipshultz LI, McLane M, et al. Long-term safety and curvature deformity characterization in patients previously treated with collagenase clostridium histolyticum for Peyronie's disease. *J Urol.* 2020;203(6):1191-1197. doi:10.1097/JU.0000000000000743
reports.followUp: Yearly visits for up to 5 years after treatment, without further collagenase

results.endpoint: Curvature change since the end of treatment
results.measure: Mean penile curvature in men previously treated with CCH who received no further treatment

values.exp: 51.8° to 31.0° at the last visit of the original study (reference; 247 men); a further 4.3° improvement at year 5 (180 men)

results.note: No comparison group. The reference visit was the last visit of the original study, after treatment: 20.9 ± 16.2° (39.5%) improvement had already occurred. The year-5 improvement was 9.1% beyond the reference value (4.3 ± 13.4°, 95% CI 2.3 to 6.2).

results.measure: Mean PDQ bother domain score in men previously treated with CCH

values.exp: 6.5 to 3.4 at the last visit of the original study (reference; 183 men); 2.4 ± 2.9 at year 5 (123 men)

results.note: No comparison group; the P value is for the change from the reference value to year 5.

harms.label: Adverse events during follow-up
harms.note: None was considered treatment related. 280 men enrolled from IMPRESS I and II and two open-label studies; 204 (73%) completed. Anti-AUX-I and anti-AUX-II seropositivity trended down at years 4 and 5.

reports.label: Response by treatment cycle
reports.citation: Ziegelmann M, Hu Y, Xiang Q, et al. Incremental treatment response by cycle with collagenase clostridium histolyticum for Peyronie's disease: a pooled analysis of two phase 3 trials. *Urology.* 2023;175:126-131. doi:10.1016/j.urology.2023.02.019

results.endpoint: Response (at least 20% curvature reduction) after cycle 1
results.measure: Proportion of CCH recipients with a 20% or greater reduction from baseline after one cycle
results.note: Post hoc, all 832 men (CCH 551, placebo 281). Mean cumulative percent reduction was significantly greater with CCH than placebo after each cycle (P<0.001).

results.measure: Proportion reaching a 20% or greater reduction by cycle 4 among CCH recipients who had not responded earlier

values.exp: 60.8% of cycle 1 failures; 42.7% of cycle 1-2 failures; 23.5% of cycle 1-3 failures

results.note: Not a randomized comparison of continuing versus stopping.
